get.description: Newest first, in the fixed order created_at desc, id desc (id only breaks ties between entries of the same instant). The order cannot be chosen, so there is no sort parameter.

parameters.description: Id of the audited object. Must be given together with subjectKind: subjectId alone answers 400, because one id can name several kinds of object; kinds without an object (REQUEST, OPERATION, LOGIN_ATTEMPT) take no subjectId.
parameters.name: subjectId

get.description: Takes the same filter parameters as the list and answers every match in the same fixed order, created_at desc, id desc, without paging. Answers 422 PLATFORM_AUDIT_EXPORT_TOO_LARGE when more entries match than the export limit allows.
